::: {#def-counterfactual-npsem .theorem}
# Counterfactual NPSEM-IE
A counterfactual NPSEM-IE is an NPSEM-IE that models the random variables in the model as they would be observed if the structural equations of the NPSEM-IE were amended in one of two ways: (a) superceding some of the values procued by the structural equations with values of the investigators choosing (node intervention), or (b) amending the structural equation itself with a function of the incestigator's choosing In each case, the structural euqations would be amended through study design.

:::
